ayahOccurrences.text: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَّشِيدٍ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: فَكَأَيِّن مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَا وَهِىَ ظَالِمَةٌ فَهِىَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَىٰ عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُّعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَّشِيدٍ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: genitive feminine indefinite (form II) passive participle
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مُّعَطَّلَةٍ is in the derivative form: مُعَطَّلَةٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ع/ط/ل   ʿ–ṭ–l to be without jewellery, to be without ornaments, to be featureless, to be without arms, to be idle, to be without work, to be without a leader, to be unattached, to make someone idle, to cause to be dysfunctional.

Of this root, 2 forms occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
عُطِّلَتْ ʿuṭṭilat and مُعَطَّلَةٌ muʿaṭṭalatun.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مُعَطَّلَةٌ muʿaṭṭalatun [pass. part.] abandoned, deserted, ruined, caused to be dysfunctional

(22:45)‏فَهِيَ خَاوِيَةٌ عَلَى عُرُوشِهَا وَبِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ وَقَصْرٍ مَشِيدٍ and now it has fallen in upon its turrets, and [how many] a deserted well, and [how many] a lofty palace.

entries.label: عُطِّلَ
entries.definitionHtml:
عُطِّلَ ʿuṭṭila [pass. v. II] to be rendered dysfunctional, to be ignored

(81:4) وَإِذَا‏ ‏الْعِشَارُ‏ ‏عُطِّلَتْ when people become too distracted to carry out the most urgent tasks‏ [literally interpreted as either: when pregnant she‐camels in their tenth month are abandoned (out of a twelve month term, and so valuable and in need of constant attention) or, when clouds heavily laden with life‐giving rain are ignored].
